## About
Pon's Auto Body & Repair Center is an independent, family run shop in Long Beach. We do collision work, body repair and painting, frame and uni-body restoration, air conditioning and mechanical repairs, all under one roof on Junipero Ave.
Our ASE certified mechanics use computer diagnostics to pinpoint problems and fix them properly, and our body work is done to the standards set by your vehicle manufacturer.
Neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 55 reviews on Google. Many of them talk about honest advice, fair pricing, and Dara's work on bumpers.

## Services
- Collision services: Comprehensive collision work to get you back on the road safely. Bring your car by and we'll look it over and give you an estimate.
- Auto body repair and painting: Dents, bumpers, fenders and paint. Reviewers mention Dara by name for bumper repairs.
- Frame and uni-body restoration: We use measuring and digital imaging systems for frame restoration and uni-body repairs, working to your vehicle manufacturer's standards.
- Air conditioning and heating: Our technicians have a solid background with automotive air conditioning and modern heating systems.
- Mechanical repairs: Mechanical work handled by our mechanics, right here in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Stop by our shop on Junipero Ave in Long Beach and we'll look at your car and give you an estimate. You can also call us at the shop.
